{{Quote|Vula, this is Mauler Control. We're aware of the situation. Where are you?|Unidentified Mauler Control to Vula|<ref name="IF" />}}
This '''Unidentified individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Mauler]]''.<ref name="IF" />

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] launched an [[Battle of Kuat (Hunt for Zsinj)|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] in his attempt to steal the newly constructed [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Razor's Kiss]]''. This unidentified individual assisted the operation by coordinating efforts between the boarding party on ''Razor's Kiss''.<ref name="IF" />
